title: Implement exact integer token billing
prompt: Compute exact billing from category->integer token-count records and category->integer microcurrency-per-million-token prices. Sum integer numerators then round HALF UP once to microcurrency units. Return (exact_numerator,settled_units). Python integers avoid overflow; prices/counts must be nonnegative integers. Rounding each row instead changes totals.
